title: Great  practice
content: The practice is always available when needed. The reception staff are helpful. The nurse practitioner was welcoming and listened and understood my concerns and dealt with them appropriately. The doctors also address any problems with  empathy and efficiently. Thank you to you all.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
